  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 02, 2023 AT 6:00 PM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design
Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City at
(626) 300­0700 or at Planning@cityofsanmarino.org at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
Via Computer for Video Streaming:
Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/5719496876
Meeting ID: 571 949 6876

How to offer public comment from home:
  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to Planning@CityofSanMarino.org before or
  during the meeting prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read during
  public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time.

  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

Alternate Suzanne Torgeson, Alternate Kimberlee Misek, Member Raymond Cheng, Member

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.CityofSanMarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review
Committee by completing a public comment card and giving it to the Community
Development Director prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Design
Review Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Design
Review Committee may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the DRC Determine that based on the whole of the administrative

  Guidelines, Article 19, Sections 15301, and there is no substantial evidence
  demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA
  Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; and
  2) Find that the proposed project meets all the required findings; and 3) Approve the
  project.

3.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  23­44 AT 2405 RIDGEWAY ROAD FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF THE
  EXISTING WOOD SHAKE ROOF WITH CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL
  SHAKE TL IN THE SOLARIS AUTUMN BLEND COLOR. (CUNNINGHAM
  & SCHLERF)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee: 1.) Determine that based on the
  whole of the administrative record, the proposed roofing project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class I (Existing facilities), and
  that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2.) Find that the
  proposed project meets all the required findings; and 3.) Approve the project with
  the added conditions that the residence install gutters and the conditions for
  composition shingle roofing material listed on the City’s Pre­Approved Roofing
  Materials, Colors, and Applications List shall be applied.

  LIST UPDATE

DIRECTOR'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the Community Development Director to inform the Design Review
Committee and the public of any matters of interest.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

ADJOURNMENT
